sentences.text: Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is the first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the applicants/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.543/2023 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Kasrawad, District Khargone (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 366A, 376, 376(2) (N) of IPC along with Section 5(L)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual 2 MCRC-19064-2024 Offences Act.

sentences.text: Prosecution story in brief is that minor prosecutrix along with her younger sister and other girls had gone outside the village for answering nature's call, but from there she did not return back and went missing.
They tried to search her everywhere, but she could not be found.
During the investigation, it was revealed that co-accused has abducted and took the prosecutrix with him and had committed rape upon her.
On the basis of aforesaid, the crime has been registered.
3 . Learned counsel for the applicants submits that applicants have not committed the offence and they have falsely been implicated in the case.
They are in jail since 18.04.2024.
They are not the main accused, who have committed rape upon prosecutrix.
There is no evidence available on record to connect the applicants with the aforesaid crime.
After completion of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
They are the permanent resident of Khargone and there is no possibility that after release they will abscond and temper with the evidence.
Trial will take considerable long time for its disposal therefore, it is prayed that the applicants be released on bail.
4 . On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has objected the prayer and prayed for its rejection.

5. Having considered the rival submissions and after perusal of the case diary so also considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that applicants deserve to be enlarged on bail, hence, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that applicants- Arjun and Subhash shall be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees 3 MCRC-19064-2024 Fifty thousand only) each with separate sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court, for their appearance before the concerned Court regularly on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during trial.

It is further directed that applicants shall comply with the provisions of Section 437 (3)
of Cr. P. C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of trial but in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
8. With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stand disposed off.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
